game.title: Atlanta Falcons at Green Bay Packers

lede: Green Bay Packers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play), while Atlanta Falcons owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#17 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Green Bay Packers -4.5 with a fair total of 45.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Green Bay Packers pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits +0.116 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
